Inspect and advance a target branch's merge queue

Usage:
  erun review queue [command]

Available Commands:
  advance          Advance a target branch's merge queue head to MERGE
  list             List a target branch's merge queue, in queue order
  override-advance Bypass the unresolved-thread gate and advance the merge queue anyway

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for queue

Global Flags:
      --erun-alias string   erun platform cloud alias to target (defaults to the sole configured erun-type alias)
      --output string       Result format: text (default, human stream) or json (structured result on stdout for orchestrators). (default "text")
      --time                Print the elapsed runtime after the command finishes.
  -v, --verbose count       Increase verbosity: -v streams external tool output, -vv adds erun command traces.

Use "erun review queue [command] --help" for more information about a command.
